CheckTitle: Ensure EPM Automate Credentials Are Protected via Secure Storage
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: EPM Cloud access (EPM Automate, Service Administrator)
Description: EPM Automate scripts must not hold plaintext passwords; use the encrypted password file or an OS key store / enterprise vault.
Risk: EPM Automate usually runs as Service Administrator, so plaintext credentials in scripts are high-value targets.
AuditProcedure: Review scripts, scheduled jobs and CI/CD that call EPM Automate for plaintext credentials.
Confirm the encrypted password file or a vault is used and credentials are rotated.

Steps: Use 'epmautomate encrypt' or a vault, update scripts and remove residual plaintext credentials.
